measurement.preconditioning: 2 * pool_blocks untimed one-block cold FIFO cycles per implementation, before prefix setup; then warmup before each trial
measurement.latency_boundary: can_allocate + allocate + deallocate; sequence construction, prefix hashing during setup, GC, and sample storage excluded
measurement.percentiles: numpy linear percentiles across all measured individual cycles
measurement.full_cycles_per_second: total measured cycles / sum of individual cycle durations
measurement.loop_cycles_per_second: total cycles / loop wall time, including sample recording
measurement.memory: sys.getsizeof recursively over reachable Python objects; identity deduplicated; includes integer keys and instance dictionaries; before timed trials and after timed trials, before releasing pinned prefixes; not RSS
measurement.scope: CPU allocator microbenchmark; does not measure tokens/s, TTFT, GPU latency, or end-to-end serving throughput
